subject: R shiny: open local pdf from a list of pdfs after clicking an action Button

messages.subject: R shiny: open local pdf from a list of pdfs after clicking an action Button
parts:
I am trying to make a webap that provides inventory information based on user queries. All of the data is located in a flat file and I am currently running R version 3.2.5 (2016-04-14) on windows 7(64bit).

I am stuck trying to figure out how to provide the corresponding pdf based on an input query after the user submits the query, followed by clicking a new action button to open the pdf. All of the pdf's( thousands of them) are stored in my www directory btw... Link to the original post:

http://stackoverflow.com/questions/39707001/r-shiny-open-local-pdf-from-a-list-of-pdfs-after-clicking-an-actionbutton?noredirect=1#comment66756006_39707001
